psutil_cpu_times_contract:
Return a (user, system, children_user, children_system)
namedtuple representing the accumulated process time, in
seconds.
This is similar to os.times() but per-process.
On macOS and Windows children_user and children_system are
always set to 0.
scope: Single partial-running Rust-controller CPU snapshot, including scheduler, monitor, logs, serialization and drain. No isolated observer/logging attribution; CPU is not removable wall time.
